sulfated_ash.calculation_note: Column 'Typical'; no Minimum/Maximum printed for this row. Chemical Characteristics table: header 'Minimum % Weight | Typical | Maximum % Weight' on p.1; the table continues on p.2 without a new header (rows in alphabetical order after PHOSPHORUS on p.1). No test method printed.
sulfated_ash.notes: Correction 2026-10-31 (audit CF-142/CF-143): this field previously held the calculated estimate 5.8 wt.% (status Calculated), now kept in alternate_entries. The product data sheet prints a typical sulfated ash, recorded here as Reported.

alternate_entries.calculation_note: Sulfated ash = (Ca_ppm×3.40 + Mg_ppm×4.95 + Zn_ppm×1.24)/10000; elements are in wt.% here, so = 3.40×1.705 (Ca) = 5.7970 → 5.8 wt.%. Mg/Zn not reported, taken as 0.
alternate_entries.notes: Sourced from calculation (ASTM D874 sulfated-ash conversion factors applied to the Ca/Mg/Zn contents in this file), not from the product datasheet. Historical estimate, superseded 2026-10-31 (audit CF-142/CF-143): it took Zn as 0 ('Mg/Zn not reported'), but this data sheet prints ZINC 0.778 typical (p.2). It is a calculation, not a reported measurement, and is kept for provenance only.

Zn.notes: Added 2026-10-31 (audit CF-142/CF-143 follow-up): printed on p.2 but previously recorded as Missing.

density.calculation_note: 'Physical Characteristics' table, 'Target' column (p.1); no Minimum or Maximum is printed for this row and no method is printed. Not converted. The specific gravity printed on the same page is recorded in specific_gravity, not here.

alternate_entries.calculation_note: Same row block, 'Target' column (p.1): the same quantity printed per imperial gallon. Not converted.

specific_gravity.calculation_note: 'Physical Characteristics' table (p.1): Minimum 0.932, Target 0.952, Maximum 0.972; value = Target, min/max = the printed Minimum/Maximum. No method printed. Not converted to density.

open_questions: Density holds 'LBS PER U.S. GAL @ 15.6 C 7.93' (Target), with 'LBS PER IMP GAL @ 15.6 C 9.52' as an alternate entry; 'SPECIFIC GRAVITY @ 15.6 C 0.932 0.952 0.972' is recorded in the optional specific_gravity property (2026-10-24).
Physical values are in the 'Target' column (target, not typical); chemical values in the 'Typical' column. KV40/flash/pour usually have no min/max.
Package TBN is printed only where the table has a 'BASE NUMBER (MGKOH/G)' row; otherwise left Missing.

[History] User decision 2026-10-17: the density field stored 0.952 (specific gravity, dimensionless) from 'SPECIFIC GRAVITY @ 15.6 C 0.932 0.952 0.972' (DL2-11503.pdf p.1). Superseded 2026-10-24 by the approved optional specific_gravity property: the specific gravity moved there and density now holds the printed 7.93 lbs/US gal @ 15.6 C.
